name: Beach Road and RK Beach
tagline: The seafront promenade and the submarine
description: The long coastal road along the Bay of Bengal, with the promenade, the beach, the INS Kursura submarine museum hauled up on the sand and most of the city's better hotels. It is where the city walks in the evening and the most pleasant address in Visakhapatnam.
bestFor: Anyone wanting the sea and the promenade at the door
pros: The seafront promenade and the beach
Best hotels and restaurants in the city
Evening walking culture along the front
cons: Among the most expensive rents locally
The beach itself is not great for swimming

name: MVP Colony
tagline: The planned residential district behind the beach
description: A well-laid-out residential area a few blocks inland from the beach road, with wide streets, apartment blocks, good schools and a strong run of restaurants and cafes. It is where much of the city's professional population lives.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting a comfortable flat near the sea
pros: Good apartment stock and reliable fibre
Ten minutes from the beach road
cons: Traffic on the main approach roads
Little to see in the district itself

name: Dwaraka Nagar
tagline: The commercial centre with the shops and the buses
description: The main shopping and commercial district in the middle of the city, dense with markets, electronics shops, cinemas and the main bus station nearby. It is loud, busy and where the practical business of Visakhapatnam is done.
bestFor: Budget stays with everything for sale on the doorstep
cons: Air quality is worst in the traffic corridors

name: Rushikonda
tagline: The IT park and the best beach
description: The coastal area north of the city holding the IT park, several institutes and the beach that is genuinely the best in the district. It is the newest part of Visakhapatnam and where its technology sector and its coworking are concentrated.
bestFor: Anyone working in or with the technology sector
pros: IT park and coworking on the doorstep
The best beach in the area
cons: Twenty minutes from the city centre
Limited beyond the IT and hotel complexes

name: Gajuwaka
tagline: The industrial south by the steel plant
description: The large district in the south of the city serving the steel plant and the port's industrial belt, dense, working class and by a distance the cheapest place to live in Visakhapatnam. It has its own markets and a life entirely separate from the beach.
bestFor: Very long stays where cost outweighs everything
pros: The lowest rents in the city
Its own markets and cheap food
Direct access to the industrial employers
cons: The worst air quality in the city
Half an hour from the beach
